task.title: Discard unterminated SSE events at end of stream
task.objective: Dispatch SSE events only after their blank-line terminator and preserve degraded completion
acceptance_criteria: An incomplete event at EOF is not dispatched
Parser-local pending event state is cleared at EOF
An unterminated terminal event cannot make stream completion successful

attempts.summary: Added parser and lifecycle regressions for an unterminated final event
attempts.diagnostic: The parser returned one final event instead of an empty event vector

attempts.summary: Removed EOF flushing and explicitly cleared incomplete parser state

outcome.summary: Only blank-line-terminated SSE events reach the transcript and incomplete stream closure remains degraded

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1080

lessons: Transport EOF is not a protocol record terminator unless the protocol explicitly defines it as one
Test terminal lifecycle effects as well as parser output when incomplete input could falsely signal success
